title: gaultheria vernalis
intro: Gaultheria vernalis, commonly known as Eastern Snowberry or Spring Snowberry, is a flowering plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gaultheria vernalis include its ability to act as an expectorant and a diuretic, helping to relieve respiratory issues and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of Gaultheria vernalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
